evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/b/i extends JButton, owns one rs/s/b/l Keybind value, exposes a setter/getter pair, and normalizes null to Keybind.NOT_SET before updating button text from value.toString().

Its constructor disables focus traversal keys, derives the default client font to 12f, installs a mouse listener that clears to NOT_SET on button-1 release, and installs a key listener that creates either Keybind or ModifierlessKeybind according to the constructor boolean.

RuneLite net.runelite.client.plugins.config.HotkeyButton has the same JButton superclass, Keybind field, constructor signature/behavior, mouse-release reset, key-press selection logic, setter semantics and font setup.

candidates.note: HotkeyButton is recovered at confidence 0.999 from an exact RuneLite source match. Its anonymous mouse/key listener implementation classes remain unnamed.
